name: ui-humanizer
works_with: Claude Code and Codex. HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React and shadcn interfaces
short: Takes the 'made with AI' look out of sites, apps, dashboards, docs and slides, with a design process and a detector script.
what: This AI skill finds and removes the habits that make an interface look AI-made: an uppercase label above every heading, a gradient word in the title, cards with a side stripe, pulsing chips, emoji as icons, Tailwind purple and pills everywhere. It is built from 51 replies to a thread on the subject. It runs a full process (brief, sketch before code, references, design system, build and audit) and ships a dependency-free detector script.
who: People building landing pages or apps with a coding agent who keep getting the same template look. If you only want a quick check, ask for an audit and it lists the problems without editing.
needs: A coding agent that loads AI skills
A browser the agent can drive, if you want it to search for visual references and take screenshots

steps.title: Copy the skill in
steps.text: Copy the `ui-humanizer` folder from the repo into `~/.claude/skills/`. The README also shows the skills CLI (`npx skills add gabrielgreco1/skills`) with `--skill` and the skill's name.

steps.title: Ask your agent
steps.text: Ask it to build or review a page and make it look less like AI. It stops for your approval after the sketch and again after the references.

steps.title: Run the detector yourself
steps.text: Replace `<arquivo-ou-pasta>` with a file or folder. Check each hit, because some are legitimate.

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: Audit this landing page for things that make it look AI-made and suggest a fix for each.

watch: The skill and its reference files are written in Portuguese. It covers copy tells in Portuguese and English.
In the references phase it searches Pinterest, Dribbble, Awwwards and similar sites in the browser.
It tells the agent never to invent clients, numbers, testimonials, logos or awards, and to use clear placeholders when real material is missing.
A project's own design system wins over this skill.
